scenario_description:
Objective: Add optional media-lab critique to improve the privacy-safe caption and alt-text set for the capstone gallery draft before the next polish block.
Emerging Need: The mini-consult is first only tentative; it becomes usable only after the timing is fixed, the desk is verified, and a short coded seat release opens.
Decision Context: Saved portfolio guidance identifies which learner-owned draft material fits the consult, what identifiers may be shared, and why prototype files, recordings, or peer comments are excluded.
Consequence: A timely seat could yield sharper portfolio narration and accessibility language; missing the same-day release leaves ordinary capstone progress and credential requirements unchanged.

parameter.subject: Possible Monday mini-consults for portfolio media notes
parameter.body: The Media Lab is checking whether a facilitator can cover a few short no-fee mini-consults on Monday morning for portfolio media notes. Scope and intake channel are not confirmed yet; details will be posted only if a release packet is approved.

parameter.title: Capstone portfolio polish block
parameter.description: Scheduler-added polish time for incorporating any optional feedback before portfolio materials are bundled for the advising discussion.

parameter.name: ID Program Media Lab Portfolio Consult Desk

parameter.notes: Directory sync verified the desk address for no-fee learner consult intake; use only course and learner-owned record identifiers unless staff requests more.

parameter.content: Release packet MLAB-CAP-0810 is live: two no-fee caption/alt-text mini-critique seats are available Monday at 10:40 and 10:55 ET. Requests must reference release token CAP-MEDIA-914 and arrive at the Portfolio Consult Desk before 16:30 ET today. Do not attach recordings or prototype files.

parameter.body: The 16:30 ET intake batch for Monday caption/alt-text mini-critique seats has closed, and token CAP-MEDIA-914 is no longer valid for this release. Later requests will be held for the next cycle after Monday's portfolio-polish period.
